generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. Every module you take sets tasks and asks you to look back on how they went; the people who do that look-back honestly, and on purpose, are the ones whose work improves from one piece to the next rather than repeating the same mistakes. Treat what follows as being about your own essays, projects and placements, not about study in the abstract.

The same habit runs through professional life. Wherever you are given work and later asked how it went, the people who get better are the ones who learn from it deliberately rather than just moving on. Learning from your own experience, and changing what you do because of it, is a habit you keep long after you graduate.
